name: com.midtrans.sdk.uikit.views.bca_klikbca.status.KlikBcaStatusActivity
description: After a user starts KlikBCA online banking payments in Midtrans UiKit checkout, this screen shows the payment result and the steps for completing the bank payment and its current transaction state.
disableEffect: Disabling it can hide the KlikBCA online banking payments payment result or the instructions needed to complete it.
